decisions.reason: The permitted circular basis v1=(1,i,0)/sqrt(2), v2=(1,-i,0)/sqrt(2) is transverse and Hermitian-orthonormal for k0=(0,0,1). Its ray [psi_0]=[v1] has no nonzero real representative: the ratio of its second to first coordinate is i. Thus the original geometric linear-polarisation label is false. Clause (b) now requires v_j=zeta*u_j for one common unit phase and a real transverse orthonormal basis; all complex pure states remain admissible. Clause (d) distinguishes arbitrary unitary sharp-measurement transport from physical linear-frame changes.
